thread:
Alexa Chen: FYI trivy returned a medium-severity glibc finding in our slimroot image (ubuntu:20.04 lineage). I want to coordinate a rebuild + tightened signing posture this week. Thinking Wed 22:00 PT. No immediate panic but we should act fast. @security-oncall @Jen Park thoughts?

Muhammad Rahman: +1 for rebuild. Proposal: create a minimally-scoped 'image-signer' service account with only kms.cryptoSign on the specific key and storage.objects.create for the attestation bucket. Tokens MUST be short-lived (1h). Don't give broad keystore or admin perms.

Jen Park: Audit side: we need signing audit events surfaced and retained longer. Current logs retention is 90d; request bump to 365d for cloudaudit activity related to CryptoKeyVersionService.AsymmetricSign and IAM permission changes. Also add alert: >1 failed sign attempt in 1h for the signer SA.

security-oncall: A couple of questions: 1) can we rotate KMS keys per-run (ephemeral key version) from CI? 2) what provenance can we prove for artifacts already out? Need to plan forensic snapshot too.

Alexa Chen: For ephemeral keys CI could create a key version, use it to cosign, then disable the version. Need to confirm KMS quotas. If that's too heavy we can instead use a long-lived asymmetric key but limit access via a short-lived SA and strict IAM conditions (e.g., source repo, signer job name).

Muhammad Rahman: Heads up: GCP KMS has quotas on key version creation (~X/sec) — might be fine for occasional rebuilds but not for many parallel jobs. Pre-warming versions or rotating through a pool is an option. Another pattern: use a single key but enforce IAM Conditions and use OIDC token audience checks in IAM binding so only CI job instances with the right claim can call AsymmetricSign.

Jen Park: For provenance: export existing cosign signatures/attestations and store them in a locked bucket with restricted ACL. Capture: image digest, cosign signature, key version, signer SA, pipeline run ID, timestamp. Add these artifacts to an evidence directory for incident forensics.

Alexa Chen: Runbook checklist draft:
- Preflight: confirm vuln, list services, impact matrix
- RBAC: create image-signer SA + IAM Condition binding; enforce 1h token TTL
- KMS: pick mode (ephemeral key-version vs single-key + strict IAM)
- Signing: update cosign step to emit attestation and copy signature to secure bucket
- Observability: add Stackdriver alert + retention change
- Deployment: Canary 2% -> 25% -> 100% with rollback gates
- Incident steps: revoke SA, disable key version, update OPA blocklist, notify customers if exploited

Jen Park: Stackdriver filter to surface sign calls (paste):

```
logName="projects/redwood-prod/logs/cloudaudit.googleapis.com%2Factivity"
protoPayload.methodName="google.cloud.kms.v1.CryptoKeyVersionService.AsymmetricSign"
protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail:"image-signer-sa@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com"
```

Alert rule: trigger when count_nonzero(status.code != 0)[1h] > 0 OR when count(AsymmetricSign[1h]) > 5 from unknown principals.

security-oncall: We will run the CVE triage. If we detect any post-deploy exploitation signs, immediate actions: 1) revoke the signer SA binding 2) disable the signing key version 3) add image digest(s) to OPA admission controller blocklist 4) rollback to previous safe image and start incident response.

Muhammad Rahman: Technical note for OPA gate: add a fast-update blocklist endpoint and a small job 'block-image-digest' that can be executed by security-oncall. I'll add an HTTP endpoint on blocker-service and a CI job to push digests. Admission controller reads the list from the blocker-service cache.

release-ci: ops-bot opened ticket RW-2026-512: "slimroot rebuild + signing posture tighten" scheduled Wed 2026-03-25 22:00 PT. Canary plan included.

Alexa Chen: Volunteers: I'll lead rebuild + attestations. Muhammad will own RBAC and blocker endpoint. Jen will own logging/alerts and retention change. security-oncall handles triage/escalation.

security-oncall: I'll be oncall that night and will coordinate. Please post the runbook PR and tagging when ready.

ops-bot: Reminder: maintenance window RW-2026-512 will post to status.redwood.ai at deploy time.

Alexa Chen: Thanks team. I'll open the runbook PR and paste links to the attestation bucket and the cosign snippet. Ping here for any blockers. :lock: :construction:
